Year 2025

Overview

A credible, contemporary voice for global dialogue.

ReModelUN is a global podcast and dialogue platform that brings together policymakers, AI experts, educators, youth leaders, and changemakers to explore ethical, AI-driven solutions for global challenges. Studio 1947 was engaged to create a distinct brand identity and communication system that could reflect the initiative's vision of combining innovation, sustainability, and collaborative problem-solving within a United Nations-inspired framework.

The project aimed to establish a credible yet contemporary presence capable of engaging global audiences across digital and event platforms.

Introduction

Rethinking global cooperation for a modern world.

Remodel UN is an innovative initiative focused on rethinking and revitalizing the structure and function of the United Nations to address modern global challenges more effectively. With a mission to foster international cooperation and sustainability, Remodel UN sought to enhance their digital presence and engagement with a global audience.

The Objective

A digital platform that mobilizes support.

Studio 1947 partnered with Remodel UN to develop a strategic digital solution that would elevate their message and expand their reach. The primary objective was to create a compelling online platform that would facilitate dialogue, promote their vision, and mobilize support for their initiatives.

Our Process

From platform to identity to content.

01

Website Development

We designed and developed a dynamic, user-centric website that serves as a hub for Remodel UN's initiatives, resources, and advocacy efforts, with intuitive navigation, engaging content, and interactive elements that encourage participation.

02

Brand Identity

We refined Remodel UN's visual identity to ensure consistency and impact across all digital and print materials, including logo design, color schemes, and typography aligned with their mission and values.

03

Content Strategy

Our team crafted a content strategy highlighting Remodel UN's key messages, success stories, and calls to action, spanning blog posts, articles, and multimedia content to engage and inform their audience.

The Result

Engagement, recognition, and awareness.

  • 01Enhanced online engagement — the new website became a central platform for Remodel UN's advocacy, attracting a global audience and fostering meaningful discussions.
  • 02A stronger brand identity — the refined visual system made Remodel UN's message more recognizable and impactful.
  • 03Increased awareness — the content strategy amplified Remodel UN's voice, raising awareness about their mission and initiatives.

Client Impact

Through our partnership, Remodel UN achieved:

  • 01A robust digital platform that supports their advocacy and engagement goals.
  • 02A cohesive and compelling brand identity that resonates with their audience.
  • 03Greater visibility and impact, driving global conversation and action.

Why Studio 1947?

We help organizations amplify their impact.

Studio 1947 is dedicated to helping organizations amplify their impact through strategic digital solutions. Our work with Remodel UN demonstrates our ability to combine creative design with effective content strategy, empowering clients to achieve their mission and engage their audience effectively.
